Commentary.Commentary: So that is it from this game! The hosts once again have emerged victorious and they would now be eyeing a whitewash. Zimbabwe, on the flip side, will hope to avoid that in the third T20I. It will be played on the 14th of October at 1430 local (1230 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!
Dane Paterson has been named the Man of the Match for his excellent bowling performance in the first innings. He ended with figures of 4-0-22-2.

Earlier in the day, the South African bowlers were on song as they restricted the tourists to a small total. Dane Paterson and Robbie Frylinck were the pick of the bowlers. Sean Williams top scored for the away side but his effort went in vain.

The visitors would have had a real chance had they taken Klaasen's catch when he was on 1, but that was not to be. Taylor dropped him and Klaasen scored some handy runs. His 44-run stand with Duminy took them closer to the finish line. He departed but the latter stayed there till the end and hit the winnings runs for the hosts with Miller supporting him. The Zimbabwe bowlers did try hard, they even bowled well, with Sean Williams being the most impressive. However, the total put up by their batsmen was way below par.

South Africa have sealed the series with a match to go. They have chased down the paltry target quite easily in the end. However, it was not as easy as it reads on the scorecard. They were rocked early as van der Dussen departed cheaply. De Kock then started finding the middle of the bat but perished after getting a start. Du Plessis too departed soon and at that time Zimbabwe must have felt they were in the game.

FOUR! That is the game! Duminy finishes it off in style. He comes down the track, gets a short ball on his hips, he helps it on its way to the square leg fence. Customary handshakes go on in the middle as SOUTH AFRICA WIN BY 6 WICKETS!
On the body of the batsman, takes off after pitching. Miller tries to flick but gets hit on the gloves and the ball rolls towards mid-wicket for a run.
A bumper on middle, the batsman ducks under it. However, the bounce is too much and it has been wided.
Back of a length around off, guided to point.
FOUR! Only 4 needed now! Slightly fuller in length around off, Miller lunges and times it through covers for a boundary.
Leans ahead and drills it down the ground to long on. Single to the total.
Closes the face of the bat and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Miller stays behind the line and blocks it out.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Full outside off, driven through covers.
Wide! Third one of the over. Down the leg side again.
Wide! Another one down the leg side, wide called.
Straighter one on middle and leg, worked away to mid-wicket.
Wide! The batsman tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire signals a wide.
Tendai Chisoro back on.
FOUR! Glorious! Too good. Extremely full outside off, Miller presents the full face of the bat and drives it through the covers for a boundary.
Off cutter on off, Miller gets a leading edge as he tries to play at it.
Wide! Angling too far down, easy call for the umpire to make.

FOUR! Room on offer and David Miller has absolutely smashed that. The sound was like the cracking of a gun. BAM! Well outside off, Miller rocks onto the back foot and sends it across the cover boundary.
Cramping the batsman for room as he keeps it close to off, David Miller plays it off the outer half in front of point.
Miller tries to do the same, but can't beat backward point who moves swiftly to his right.
Length delivery straightening up after hitting the deck, around off, Duminy opens the face and runs it down to third man for a run.
Chris Mpofu called back into the attack.
Knocks it down to long on and keeps strike. 23 more to win off 42.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Stumping chance missed! Difficult take for Taylor. Oof! No chance for him. Miller comes down the track to work it on the leg side but it goes through his legs after taking the inside edge, past the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Whips this away to deep backward square leg for a single.
Wide! Fires it down leg, Duminy misses the attempted paddle. Wide signalled by the umpire.
David Miller to bat next.

OUT! Another wicket goes down as Klaasen makes the long walk back. Trying to go big again by going across the line, Heinrich is down on one knee and gets a big top edge on the slog sweep. Skies over mid-wicket and straight down the throat of Mavuta in the deep. He needs a couple of attempts but eventually holds on to it.
Straighter in line, flicked away on the leg side for a single.
Sean Williams returns.
Sweeps it again, all along the ground. Finds the fielder though this time and only a run. 17 from the over and the hosts need another 32.
Eases it down to long on and takes a run. 100 up for South Africa.

FOUR! Klaasen joins the party now! He goes down on one knee, nails the sweep and right in the gap between deep mid-wicket and deep square leg for a boundary. This is probably the over which takes the game away from Zimbabwe. 15 from it and still 2 balls to go.
Goes for the reverse sweep again and hits it towards point for a run.

SIX! Duminy on the charge here! Targtes the short boundary and clears it with ease. Gets down on one knee, goes for the slog sweep and connects well. It sails over the mid-wicket fence. 10 from the first two balls.
FOUR! Nicely played there! Brings out the reverse sweep and hits it very fine through the off side. No stopping that and the ball races away. 45 needed in another 50 balls.
Change of ends for Brandon Mavuta.
Makes room and tries to go inside out over covers. Mistimes it and gets only a run.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman.
Duminy makes room and the bowler tries to follow him. Ends up bowling it down the leg side. The batsman misses the pull and it is wided.
Fires it outside off, Duminy chops it to short third man.
Very full and on the pads, Klaasen flicks it towards short fine leg for a run.
SIX! Short and it has been put away! Klaasen there had all the time to pull this delivery into the stands. A nothing ball that. The drop is proving very costly here.
Slightly short and outside off, the batsman cuts but finds point.
Tendai Chisoro is back on.
Slider coming in with the angle, flicked through mid-wicket. One run to end the over. At the halfway mark, South Africa are 75/3 and need 58 to win in 60.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Waits for the ball before working it off his pads on the leg side for a single.
SIX! Clean as a whistle! Super stuff from Heinrich Klaasen. Loopy and spinning away from around off, Klaasen opens his body up, goes inside out and lofts it over the cover boundary.

Touch unfortunate. Klaasen drives this straight back and it hits the stumps at the other end. Duminy takes off, but then retreats just in time as Williams uproots the stumps after collecting the ball.
Short and quick, around off, punched away from the back foot.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. End of the over.
Slower through the air on the stumps, Klaasen gets low and gets a top edge as he lobs the slog sweep over mid-wicket. One run to the total.
Hangs back and keeps it out off the back foot.

Dropped! Difficult chance, but he should have taken that. It's such a game that these kind of opportunities change the complexion of the game. Mavuta serves it on middle, shorter in length and it turns away. Klaasen goes back to cut and gets a nick behind. Taylor can't keep a hold of it.
Good stuff. Duminy plays this with soft hands as he drops it into the covers and scampers through.
Loops it up on middle and leg, JP flicks but can't beat the man at mid-wicket.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single. A wicket and 7 runs off it.
Too full and quite straight, worked in front of mid-wicket.
FOUR! Full and darted on off, Duminy shifts his weight onto the front foot and drives it through the covers. Beats the chasing fielder and gets to the rope first.
Quicker, short and outside off, Klaasen gets off the mark with a punch down to long off for a single.
Heinrich Klaasen is the new man in.

OUT! What a ball! Wow. Faf du Plessis has played down the wrong line and he's out of here. Williams delivers almost instantly. Lands it on middle and off from around the wicket and it spins away ever so slightly. The Protea skipper misses and the off stump is disturbed. Big blow to South Africa.
Darts it in on the pads, Duminy flicks it away square on the leg side and takes a single.
Sean Williams will bowl once more.
Turning in on the pads, clipped wide of short fine leg. JP will keep strike as he jogs across to the other end.
Fraction straight in line, wristed just wide of short mid-wicket. Easy run collected.
Floated around leg, flicked behind square on the leg side for a run.
Leg spinner around off, shorter in length, punched through the gap on the off side. One run taken.
Short and wide outside off, cut through to deep backward point for one.
Wide! Loopy and down the leg side, Duminy tries to paddle it fine but misses. Wide signalled.
JP Duminy walks into the middle next.

OUT! Bowled 'em! A bit of good fortune for Zimbabwe, but that's just what they needed. Quicker one around off which skids off the surface, de Kock stays back to defend but the ball comes on a bit quicker than he expects it to. It takes the inside edge, thuds onto his pads and deflects onto the stumps behind.
FOUR! Excellent. Shot from a man oozing with class. Overpitched outside off, du Plessis drives the half-volley through the gap in the covers and sends it across the boundary line.

FOUR! Full in length just outside off, Faf moves across the stumps, gets low and scoops it down towards fine leg. Mpofu attempts to stop it with a slide, but his leg is touching the rope as he's doing so. So, a boundary is given.
Shouts of catch it but it's well short. Slower one, fullish in pace this time around off. Quinton de Kock mistimes the loft towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Shot. Showing his intent here by attacking Jarvis. Shortish in length, de Kock comes out of his crease and cuts this nicely past the diving point fielder for a boundary.

SIX! That is outta here! Wow. Powerful hit from Quinton de Kock. He predicts the incoming short ball, so he walks across, positions himself and blasts the pull over backward square leg for a huge maximum.
Back of a length delivery shaping back in on off, du Plessis rises on his toes and works it down on the leg side. One run taken.
Kyle Jarvis is back.
Another short ball on the pads, de Kock tries to pull but gets it off the inner half towards short fine leg. So just a boundary from the over.
Makes room again and Mavuta fires it wide outside off, de Kock misses.

FOUR! That should release the pressure that was bulding! Picked his spot to perfection there. De kock makes room and the bowler follows him. He half-pulls it over the square leg region for a boundary.
A low full toss outside off, de Kock drives but finds cover.
Very full and outside off, de Kock tries to sweep but misses.
Shortish and outside off, de Kock finds point with the cut host.
Brandon Mavuta to roll his arm over.
Deceives the South African skipper with the slower one. Hurls it wide outside off, Faf goes after it but fails to connect.
Over the wicket, fuller in length around off, Faf defends it with the full face of the bat.
Short of a good length outside off, cut behind point, down towards third man for a single.
Angling in from around the wicket, on middle and leg, de Kock waits for it, uses the angle well and flicks it well through mid-wicket. In the gap and that's two runs to his name.
Full delivery moving away around off, du Plessis drives it back to the right of the bowler. A single is taken.
Faf du Plessis is the next batsman in.

OUT! Mpofu draws first blood. Good bowling, this. He lands it on a length and it straightens up just a shade. It's enough as van der Dussen closes the face early to flick it away. It pops off the leading edge and lobs back towards Mpofu, who gets low and takes a comfortable catch.
FOUR! Width offered and it's put away. Too full, too wide outside off, de Kock gets low and drills this through the big gap in the covers for a boundary.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
Shorter in length, van der Dussen stays back and keeps it out.
Flicks this full ball through the mid-wicket region for a run.
Quick and darted around off, going across, de Kock gets low to sweep it away again but is caught on the pads. It was missing off because of the angle.

Out? No? Well, the umpire doesn't seem to think so. But, replays show maybe there is some glove on it. Quicker and straighter on middle and leg, de Kock looks to slog sweep this away but misses and it goes off something before Taylor takes it to his left. Stifled shout, but it's denied. Zimbabwe are unfortunate here.
Tendai Chisoro into the attack now.
FOUR! Too wide and it's been punished. Short and well outside off, van der Dussen accepts the gift gleefully as he stands tall and flays it over point. No stopping that one.
Back to over the wicket, on a length on off, Rassie punches it square with an open face to point.
De Kock walks down the track to this length ball angling in on middle and leg and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Switches the angle again for the left-hander, in the off stump channel, de Kock pushes it to covers.
From over the wicket, it's on a length on middle and off this time, it's played off the inner half to mid-wicket for one more.
Length delivery on off from around the wicket, de Kock stays back and places it behind point for a single.
Chris Mpofu will bowl from the other end.

SIX! BANG! A biggie to end the over! 9 from the first over! The key there was Klaasen picked the length early. Short and on middle, Dussen rocks back and pulls it over the square leg region for a biggie.

on the fuller side on off, de Kock strokes it towards mid off and sets off for a run. The fielder at mid off, Peter Moor, picks the ball up and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batsman is in. De Kock is off the mark.
Around middle, the batsman clips it towards mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Drags his length back a little bit and also gets it to bounce. The batter goes for the booming drive but misses.
Goes fuller in length on off, de Kock drives it nicely but finds the man at covers.
WIDE! Too wide outside off, left alone. The umpire stretches his hands sideways.
South Africa are underway off the first ball! On a length and it comes back in after pitching on middle, Dussen works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
We are back for the chase! Quinton de Kock and Rassie van der Dussen are the openers for South Africa. Kyle Jarvis will start the proceedings for Zimbabwe.
